title: Weather and lightning
summary: If you can hear thunder, get inside a building or hard-topped vehicle.

list: Tall, building clouds by early afternoon mean thunderstorms are likely. In summer mountains, be off peaks and ridges by early afternoon.
Clouds that lower and thicken through the day usually mean rain within hours. A sudden wind shift with a drop in temperature means a front is arriving.

blocks.cap: Sound travels about a mile every 5 seconds; light arrives almost instantly.

list: If you can hear thunder, get inside a building or hard-topped vehicle. Tents and open shelters don’t protect you.
No place outside is safe. If you’re caught out, get off peaks and ridges and away from lone tall trees, water and metal. Don’t lie flat on the ground, and spread a group out.
Wait 30 minutes after the last thunder before going back out.
